answer: The vault schedule is applied in voyage and relic makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4468 identities would post 3490 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
